questions.prompt: The Follow button should be blue, but it has no background. Click the line with the bug.
questions.explanation: To read a custom property you must wrap it in `var()`: `background: var(--primary);`. On its own, `--primary` is not a valid value, so the line is ignored.

questions.prompt: No element sets `--story-color`. What color is the story ring?

options.text: No border at all, because the variable is missing

questions.explanation: The second argument of `var()` is the fallback. It is used when the custom property is not set on the element or any of its ancestors.

questions.prompt: How much padding does the story bar get?

options.text: 0, because `.story-bar` is not inside `.post-card`, so it does not inherit `--card-padding`

questions.explanation: A custom property only reaches the element it is set on and its descendants. `.story-bar` is a sibling, so `var(--card-padding)` has no value and no fallback, and `padding` falls back to its initial value, 0. Set shared values on `:host` so the whole component sees them.

questions.prompt: Profile grid images should be squares. With this SCSS they are squares, but the photos look stretched. What is missing?
questions.explanation: When an `` box has a different shape from the photo, the photo is stretched to fill it. `object-fit: cover` keeps the photo's proportions and crops it to fill the box. `background-size` is only for background images.

questions.prompt: The feed's parent is 400px wide. How wide is the feed?
questions.explanation: `min()` uses the smaller value. 100% of 400px is 400px, which is smaller than 630px. On a wide parent the feed stops at 630px. It is the same as `width: 100%; max-width: 630px;`.

questions.prompt: The search box should be the full width minus 32px for the icon, but the build fails. Click the line with the bug.
questions.explanation: Inside `calc()`, `+` and `-` need a space on both sides. Sass stops with `"+" and "-" must be surrounded by whitespace in calculations` (in plain CSS the browser would silently ignore the line). Fix: `calc(100% - 32px)`.

questions.prompt: The post card should switch to a side-by-side layout when its column is wider than 500px. The rule inside the container query never applies. Why?

options.text: No ancestor is a container; `.post-column` needs `container-type: inline-size`
`@container` must be written inside the `.post-card` rule
Container queries only work with grid

questions.explanation: `@container` looks for the nearest ancestor that is declared as a container. Without `container-type`, there is none, so the query never matches.

questions.prompt: Write a selector for `.post-card` elements that **contain** an element with the class `post-video`.
questions.explanation: `:has()` matches an element based on what is inside it. `.post-card:has(.post-video)` selects the card, not the video.

questions.prompt: The app is in Hebrew (`dir="rtl"`). The icon should have 8px of space between it and the text after it, but the space is on the wrong side. What is the best fix?
questions.explanation: `margin-inline-end` means "after the element, in the reading direction": on the right in English and on the left in Hebrew. `margin-left` would fix Hebrew but break English. Logical properties work in both.

questions.prompt: The page is `dir="rtl"`. The bookmark is the last icon and should be alone at the far **left**. Where does it end up?

options.text: Right next to the other icons, because in RTL the free space is already on the left and the margin pushes the bookmark toward them
In the middle of the row

questions.explanation: In RTL, flex items start on the right, so the bookmark (last item) is the leftmost. `margin-left: auto` puts the free space on its left, which keeps it next to the others. `margin-inline-start: auto` works in both directions.

questions.prompt: The stories have no space between them. Click the line with the bug.
questions.explanation: `var()` cannot be glued to a unit. `var(--gap)px` becomes `8 px` (two separate pieces), which is invalid, so `gap` falls back to its default. Fix: keep the unit in the variable (`--gap: 8px;` and `gap: var(--gap);`).

questions.prompt: The app sets `--text-color` globally and changes it in dark mode. Everything changes color except the username, which stays dark on a dark background. What is the cause?

options.text: The username uses a hard-coded color instead of `var(--text-color)`
The dark mode class must be on the username itself
Custom properties cannot be used inside `:host`

questions.explanation: A theme only changes the elements that read the variables. Any hard-coded color stays the same in every theme. Use the variable everywhere: `color: var(--text-color);`.
